lore.syncretism: Jǫrð appears within the Norse tradition and has influenced later retellings, artistic depictions, and scholarly study. The Unicode restoration preserves the name's distinctive orthography for contemporary use.
lore.culturalLegacy: Jǫrð continues to appear in scholarship, art, and popular reception as a significant figure of the Norse tradition. Restoring the name in Unicode returns the original marks that ASCII removes.
lore.extendedMeditation: Jǫrð embodies earth, mother of thor in the Norse imagination. The name's restoration is not merely cosmetic: it recovers the stress, length, and script that make the figure recognizable in the source tradition.
lore.archaeology: Jǫrð is attested in the textual and iconographic record of the Norse tradition.
